description: WorkforceVision Org Chart Drag & Drop lets HR and finance teams design organisation structures directly in Power BI, drag-and-drop editing, scenario planning, matrix (dotted-line) reporting, and export to Excel, PDF, and SVG, all within your data model. Questions, feature requests or want a Demo and help getting set up: irawatt@workforcevision.co.uk · Finalist, UK Business Tech Awards 2026, Best Use of Innovation. Trusted by 100+ organisations globally, including enterprises with 100,000+ employees. Download the sample report to explore full functionality in Power BI. Watch the video demo. A licence is required for all users. See Licensing and pricing for FAQs and assignment via Microsoft 365, or use our licence calculator to compare plans. LinkedIn Key Features: • Drag-and-Drop Org Design: Restructure teams and reporting lines in the report. • Scenario Planning: Model changes, save per-user scenarios, and track a full audit trail. • Matrix Reporting: Solid and dotted lines for complex, multi-manager structures. • Branch Filtering & Search: Focus on branches and navigate large hierarchies with ease. • Rich Node Data: Headcount, costs, KPIs, roles, and other bound fields on each card. • Custom Styling & Legend: Icons, colours, borders, and a built-in legend for clarity. • Export: Excel change logs; PDF (selectable text) and SVG (re-importable into Power BI). • Built for Scale:…
